user.title: Seeed HA Device
user.description: Add a Seeed HA WiFi device. Enter the IP address of your ESP32 device.

zeroconf_confirm.title: WiFi Device Discovered

bluetooth_confirm.title: Bluetooth Device Discovered

confirm_already_connected.title: ⚠️ Device Already Connected

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Please check IP address and network connection.
error.timeout: Connection timeout. Please check if device is online.

init.title: Configure Entity Subscription
init.description:
Select Home Assistant entities to push to **{device_name}**.

The selected entities' states will be sent to your Arduino device in real-time, allowing your device to display or use these values.

wifi_entities.title: Configure Entity Subscription
wifi_entities.description:
Select Home Assistant entities to push to **{device_name}**.

The selected entities' states will be sent to your Arduino device in real-time, allowing your device to display or use these values.

ble_entities.title: Configure BLE Entity Subscription
ble_entities.description:
Select Home Assistant entities to push to **{device_name}** via Bluetooth.

⚠️ **Note:** BLE has limited bandwidth. Maximum **{max_entities}** entities can be subscribed.

The entities will be assigned indices 0, 1, 2... in the order you select them. Make sure your Arduino code subscribes to the same indices.

ir.title: Configure IR Mate
ir.description:
Manage **{device_name}** inside Seeed HA Discovery.

Appliances: **{appliance_count}** · Learned commands stored in Home Assistant: **{learned_count}** · Touch profile revision: **{revision}/{device_revision}**

ir_add_appliance.title: Add an IR appliance
ir_add_appliance.description: Select the brand profile and give this appliance a recognizable name.

ir_delete_appliance.title: Delete an IR appliance
ir_delete_appliance.description: Select the appliance to remove. Its learned commands and touch references will also be removed.

ir_learn_command.title: Learn or replace a command
ir_learn_command.description: Select a command, submit the form, then point the original remote at IR Mate and press the matching button within 30 seconds.

ir_learn_new_command.title: Learn a custom command
ir_learn_new_command.description: Choose an appliance, name the new command, submit the form, then press the matching button on the original remote within 30 seconds.

ir_test_command.title: Test an IR command
ir_test_command.description: Select a command to transmit immediately.

ir_delete_command.title: Delete a learned command
ir_delete_command.description: Select the learned command to remove from Home Assistant storage.

ir_touch_bindings.title: Configure offline touch actions
ir_touch_bindings.description: Assign an available command to each gesture. Saving copies these four actions to IR Mate for offline use.

error.ir_operation_failed: The IR Mate operation failed. Check the device connection and try again.
error.ir_learning_failed: No valid infrared signal was learned. Point the original remote at IR Mate and try again.

abort.ble_not_supported: BLE devices do not support entity subscription. This feature is only available for WiFi devices.
abort.ble_control_not_supported: This BLE device does not support bidirectional communication. Entity subscription requires a device with GATT control service enabled.
abort.ir_not_available: IR Mate management is not available for this device.
